result.title: Result percentages
result.intro: Home, draw and away probabilities shown on the match page.

statsPredictor.title: Stats predictor
statsPredictor.intro: What each team is expected to get in xG, shots, shots on target, corners, fouls and yellow cards, on the match page. Here: whether it gets right which team gets more.

cornerDuel.title: Corner duel
cornerDuel.intro: The probability of each team taking more corners than the other, on the match page.

probablePicks.title: Likely picks
probablePicks.intro: Patterns a team has repeated many times, checked against what the opponent does, up to 6 per match.

highProbability.title: High probability
highProbability.intro: At most one selection per match from the pattern model.

result_1x2.title: Most likely result (1X2)
result_1x2.what: Whether it gets right who wins or whether it is a draw.

result_double.title: Best double chance
result_double.what: Whether it gets right the most likely double chance: 1X, X2 or 12.

probable_picks.title: Likely picks
probable_picks.what: Whether each match's likely picks come true.

high_probability.title: High probability
high_probability.what: Whether the match's high-probability selection comes true.

stats_predictor.title: Predictor: which team gets more
stats_predictor.what: Whether it gets right which team gets more shots, corners, fouls or yellow cards.

corner_duel.title: Corner duel: most likely result
corner_duel.what: Whether it gets right which team takes more corners.

uncalibratedNote: The Champions League is not part of this model's evaluation: its figures are shown, but they do not count in the totals.

caption.breakdown: {{model}}, {{breakdown}}: predictions, hit rate, without a model and edge

originOnly.reconstructed: All calculated with the data from before each match.

noData: No data for this league and season.

where.title: Where they are right most
where.intro: For the season chosen above. The hit rate shows where it is easy to be right; the edge, where the model adds something over not using one.
where.noValue: A model being right a lot with a league or a team does not mean there is value in betting: the market already prices it in.

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.caption: Hit rate of each model in each league, with its edge over the baseline
leagues.note: ▲ highest and ▼ lowest for each model, leaving out leagues with little data. Last row: whether the order of the leagues repeats from one season to the next.
leagues.oneLeague: With one league chosen above there are no leagues to compare: choose “All” under League.

overview.title: Hit rate of each model
overview.intro: How often each model was right for the league and season chosen above. Tap a card to see its details.

glossaryLink: What does each figure mean? We explain it in the <glossary>glossary</glossary>.

teams.title: Teams
teams.note: Each row counts the predictions from the matches the team plays in, including those about the opponent. “Little data”: fewer than {{n}}. Tap a team to see its matches.
teams.empty: No teams with this model in this league and season.
teams.caption: {{model}}: hits, matches and hit rate of each team
teams.noMatches: No matches with this model in this league and season.
teams.legend: ✓ came true · ✗ did not · = tie in that stat (does not count). Everything was calculated only with data from before each match; “saved before” marks what was saved before kick-off and left untouched.
